title: M3-3 final directive Phase B: corrected league-constrained evaluation from pinned inputs
objective: Resolve PB-AUD-01 to -06 and -08 and verify the Phase B v1 results: content-level live reconciliation, fail-closed ownership replay verified at every snapshot moment, availability reconstruction validated against observed snapshot states, all-week bootstrap, streaming feasibility and collisions, exact decision sets and comparable manager decisions, immutable pinned league inputs; a separately versioned corrected C05L-2026-EXP (v2) declared before it is computed, v1 preserved.

review.summary: Reconciled PB-AUD-01 to -06, -08 and the section 8 numbers against code at 2e2520f, the database and ESPN: live checks compared only id, type and status; the replay ignored trades and would fall back to proposal time for a waiver (no case in data: 52/52 executed waivers have processed_at; trade items only on 2 canceled proposals); the availability rule ignored game locks and processing times (ESPN processes at midnight Pacific; all unowned units go on waivers after their game until Wednesday); the bootstrap dropped zero-change weeks (reproduced -90.05/+80.00 vs -96.03/+74.02); streaming picks collide; decision receipts lacked candidate sets; inputs were read live. Observed rosters never exceed 16 non-IR players; D/ST limit 3.

plan.summary: 1) Pin the normalized league inputs (one read-only transaction; hashed local bundle; committed manifest). 2) Declare C05L-2026-EXP v2 (fail-closed replay verified at every snapshot; availability rule v2 with predeclared holdout acceptance; cutoff classes; all-week bootstrap; feasibility and collisions; exact decision sets; comparable managers; eligibility-aware matchups; v1 comparison) and push before computing. 3) Implement in ffa_history, league, a v2 script reading only the bundle, and content-level live checks in the inventory. 4) Recorded runs from clean commits. 5) Docs and register closure.

implementation.summary: ffa_2026_pin.py (bundle inputs-v1, manifest c354dcca, 9 files); ffa_history: UnsupportedHistory, validate_draft, processing_moments, availability_v2 (lock strictly before the moment); league: summarize blocks ALL_WEEKS/CHANGED_WEEKS with block counts and missing coverage, feasibility, collisions, matchup_effects_v2; dvp_league_2026_v2.py (pinned bundle only; ownership at every snapshot; availability validation design/holdout/decision moments; cutoff classes; four decision kinds with exact option sets, evidence, feasibility, owner at game; managers split; matchups; v1 comparison); ffa_2026_inventory.py --content (read-only alias lookups; transactions by Arbit's content hash over the union of pages; lineups by capture hash then field by field). A trial exposed the game lock compared with <= at the exact cutoff, contrary to the declared rule; fixed before the recorded run (trial output discarded). Receipts: ffa-2026-inventory-v2.json and league-2026-exploratory-v2.json at 39f763e.
